   OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTRICT
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Monday, September 12, 2022

1.  The meeting was called to order by Chairperson Craig Walters at 8:38 a.m.

  Advisory Board Members present: Craig Walters, Micky Rehm, and Marianne Stark.
  City Representative present: Secretary Natalie Hiatt. Others present: Fang Wang, Ken
  Valmonte, and Francisco Ramirez.

2.  CALENDAR

  Beer Walk – Saturday, October 15, 2022
  Heart of the Foothills Open Streets – Sunday, April 23, 2023

3.  APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES

  It was moved by Ms. Rehm and seconded by Ms. Stark to approve the minutes of July 11,
  2022 and August 1, 2022. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

4.  NEW BUSINESS

  A. Board Vacancy – One application was received from George Henderson of Henderson
  Insurance. It was moved by Ms. Stark and seconded by Ms. Rehm to recommend
  approval by the City Council. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  B. Transfer to Association – Continued to the next meeting

5.  CONTINUED BUSINESS

  A.  Beer Walk Update – Ms. Rehm stated that more sponsors are needed, Russ has
  secured 15 breweries, and Roberta of the Village Inn will order the paper good
  supplies.
  B.  Mainiero Square Update – Continued to the next meeting
  C.
6.  COMMITTEE REPORTS/ UPDATES

  A.  City Report (Eric Scherer): None
  B.  University Report (Zuhey Espinoza): None
  C.  Marketing (Micky Rehm): The Old Town Instagram has been suspended. Ms.
  Rehm will investigate further and try to have it re-instated.
  D.  Chamber Report (Leah Skinner): None
  E.  Social Media Update (Micky Rehm): None
  F.  Financial Report: None
